meta.source: xDev Hive logo (HIVE / DEV HUB, 2026-09-30) and apps/web/src/styles.css token names

tokens.name: brand-sky
tokens.usage: First stop of the logo X gradient. Highlights in brand art (cover, empty-state art); never text.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the logo X gradient. Brand art and charts' first series; never body text.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Last stop of the logo X gradient. The brand's strongest blue for brand art; UI actions use `accent`.

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: The logo's dark ground in both themes: app icon tile, desktop splash, the dark logo's background.

tokens.name: brand-letter
tokens.usage: HIVE / DEV HUB lettering colour of the logo. Matches `body` in light.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind the app shell (Tailwind `bg-canvas`).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sidebar, dialogs, inputs. Dark surface is the logo navy.

tokens.name: subtle
tokens.usage: Hovered rows, table headers, segmented-control track, code blocks on `surface`.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Read-only fields and copy boxes (tokens, commands).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, product name, numbers that matter. On `canvas`, `surface`, `subtle`, `sunken` in both themes (≥ 12:1).

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Running text and table cells on `canvas`, `surface`, `subtle` (≥ 8:1 light, ≥ 9:1 dark).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, timestamps, breadcrumbs, captions on `canvas`, `surface`, `subtle` (≥ 5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Decorative only: separators' dots, disabled icon strokes. Never for text (below 4.5:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers and card borders. Not for control borders (too faint).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, select and checkbox borders: ≥ 3:1 on `surface`, `canvas`, `subtle` in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, the active nav item's marker, progress. Text use on `surface`/`canvas` (≥ 6:1). One primary action per view.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `accent` fills and links.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent` and `accent-hover` fills (≥ 6:1). Dark theme uses dark text because the dark accent is light.

tokens.name: sel
tokens.usage: Selected row, selected nav item, running/active status chip background.

tokens.name: sel-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `sel` (≥ 7:1).

tokens.name: sel-line
tokens.usage: Border of selected cards and the selected option in pickers.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. ≥ 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success text and icons (run succeeded, PR merged, machine online) on `surface` and `ok-bg`. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Success chip and banner background.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Waiting / needs attention text and icons (waiting for CI, needs review, budget near limit) on `surface` and `warn-bg`.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Warning chip and banner background.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Failure text and icons (run failed, merge failed, machine offline, form errors) on `surface` and `bad-bg`. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: bad-bg
tokens.usage: Error chip and banner background.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and the mobile sidebar.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Page title in the top bar (`text-3xl`).

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The one key figure on cost and dashboard cards; tabular figures.

styles.name: product-name
styles.usage: Product name beside the logo in the sidebar (`text-xl`).

styles.name: card-title
styles.sample: Kênh Telegram của nhóm quản trị

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Run của TASK-42 thất bại sau 3 lần thử.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Branch names, SHAs, ids, commands, tokens (`text-sm font-mono`).

spacing.note: Tailwind's 4px scale with half steps; these are the steps the app uses.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudge inside chips.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inline controls; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Sidebar item padding; input horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; gap inside cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; page side gutter minimum.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page top padding; gap before a new page section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; login card padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Sidebar items, chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, org avatar.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Org switcher, toasts, banners.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-app
tokens.usage: Cards that float over `canvas` (login card, menus). Most cards use a `line` border instead.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and popovers above `backdrop`.
